root.name: Queen's Gambit Accepted: Alekhine Defense
root.moves: 1. d4 d5 2. c4 dxc4 3. Nf3 a6

overview: After 1.d4 d5 2.c4 dxc4 3.Nf3 Black plays 3...a6, a flexible waiting move that prepares ...b5 to hold the c4 pawn and often keeps ...Nf6 or ...c5 in reserve. White usually plays 4.e3 e6 5.Bxc4 c5, regaining the pawn with a normal QGA position, or 4.a4 or 4.e4. The game leads to open central play with Black using ...c5 and ...Nc6 against an isolated or hanging pawn White centre.

white_ideas.idea: Regain the c4 pawn with e3 and Bxc4, then castle and play Qe2 and Rd1
Use a4 or e4 to prevent ...b5 and take a central space advantage

black_ideas.idea: Play ...a6 and ...b5 to keep the pawn if possible, else regain central equality with ...c5 and ...Nc6
Develop the bishop to b7 and trade pieces

typical_structures.structure: Standard QGA with c4 pawn captured; White often gets an IQP or hanging pawn after ...c5 and dxc5 or Nc3

character.notes: A quiet queenside-opening line with little forcing play; neither side is at risk. Balanced.

gambit.notes: The c4 pawn comes back by force in most lines.

soundness.notes: Sound; the Alekhine move 3...a6 is a respectable if less common choice.

structure.notes: QGA-type open centre once White takes with a pawn on c5/d4.

approach.notes: 3...a6 is played by strong players now and then as an alternative to 3...Nf6; standard.

level.notes: Little to memorise; the plans are clear once White has regained c4. Intermediate.

sublines_that_differ.name: Haberditz Variation
sublines_that_differ.how: Black keeps the pawn with ...b5, leading to messier complications after 5.a4 c6 or 5.Qe2.

sublines_that_differ.name: Borisenko-Furman Variation
sublines_that_differ.how: White takes a space-gaining centre immediately, more aggressive.

character.reason: A QGA-type position with trades and no sharp tactics or very hard-to-break structure.

gambit.reason: The pawn on c4 comes back, a QGA.

structure.reason: The QGA structure is open, like its anchor.

approach.reason: A less common but respectable branch.

level.reason: Plans are straightforward; little long theory.

plans.reason: Black can aim at ...b5 and queenside space.
